scope: Baseline visual review of original water-plant positions before source cleanup. Read-only local evidence; no deployment proof.

lilies.defect: Separated points through open swimming water

bankPlants.defect: East-side stalk silhouettes cross actual limestone paving

sourceFindings.interactionState: No changes to birds, fish, accepted clocks, feeding or resources
